notes.subject: התקוששו וקושו
notes.rationale: daɲɛ kelen fila-fila min bɛ kɔrɔfɔ li kelen kɛ — lamini/lamini kokura, Bamanankan na a dogoya dɔɔni

notes.subject: לא נכסף
notes.rationale: 'min tɛ munu' (not longed for) walima 'min malo tɛ kɔnɔ' (without shame, JPS) — ninkan dɔw bɛ כסף II (ma-shame) laɲini

notes.subject: aw y'aw lamini
notes.rationale: weleli-daɲɛw (imperatives) bɛ siya min bɛ daminɛ in wele

notes.subject: siya
notes.rationale: kuma da kɛrɛnkɛrɛnne bɛ siratigi jamana kan (Yuda siya)

translation: Aw y'aw lamini, aw lamini kokura, a siya min tɛ munu!
